record.summary: A General Assembly resolution of 1 July 2024 on enhancing international cooperation on capacity-building in artificial intelligence. With resolution 78/265 on safe, secure and trustworthy AI, it is one of the two resolutions on AI that the Assembly adopted in 2024; the Secretary-General's High-level Advisory Body on AI read the two as acknowledgement among leading AI nations that representation gaps in international AI governance need to be addressed.
record.notes: Adopted on 1 July 2024. It and resolution 78/265 (UN-02) are recalled in resolution 79/325 of 26 August 2025 (UN-07), which establishes the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI and the Global Dialogue on AI Governance and lists AI capacity gaps among the Dialogue's topics.

verification.note: The resolution's own text could not be stored: the UN Digital Library record (official_url) returns a bot-check page, documents.un.org is closed to automated downloads by robots.txt, and the press.un.org meeting coverage requested in this run returned a JavaScript 'Client Challenge' page also in a browser. Stored in this run: A/RES/79/325 (un.org PDF), which recalls '78/311 of 1 July 2024', and the High-level Advisory Body's final report (un.org PDF), which gives the title with '(78/311)' and its reading of the two 2024 resolutions (paragraph 70). No stored file describes the resolution's operative content, so the summary is limited to what these files show; version 1's 'China-led', its account of the content, the evaluative sentence, the 97th plenary meeting, the document date of 5 July 2024 and the Group of Friends were removed.
